description: The top of the guide: the glowing PLATINUM ROAD masthead sign over its sunset band, the neon-road progress bar at 15% with grade chips, the full dash control row (search, kind/grade/state filters, spoiler shield, export/import), and the first checklist cards with EARNED stamps and guide lines showing.

The roadmap section: all six stages to the platinum rendered as green highway exit signs — First Tank of Gas, The Named Jobs, Friends & Strangers, See All of Leonida, Side Hustles and The Last Mile — each with its trophy chips and per-stage earned progress.

A trophy guide detail view open on The Shootist (silver): the official description, kind and grade, the full own-words guide, the sources line, and the Shooting Range gold-medal target counter part-filled at 27 of 42.

The checklist with the spoiler shield switched ON: the dash toggle visibly on, and unearned story trophies in the grid masked and blurred so their names and descriptions cannot be read, while earned and non-story trophies stay visible.
